title: Siterra case contracts
description: Records of one Siterra case as stored and exchanged between the web application, the worker and the browser. The root validates a case snapshot, a command, an event or an atomic commit proposal; $defs holds the record types. Cross-record semantics that JSON Schema cannot express are specified in docs/reference/data-contracts.md.

publicationDate.description: Publication date as the source states it: a full date, a year and month, or a year (widened in 1.4.0 from a full date only; never padded to a full date).

language.description: BCP 47 tag of the source text, checked from the stored text where one exists (added in 1.5.0, optional). A statement drafted in English from a source in another language is a machine-drafted translation.

manifestUri.description: URI of the bundle collection.json, absolute or relative to the application origin (widened in 1.6.0 from an absolute URI).

kind.description: explanation_branches added in 1.9.0; it replaces hypothesis_comparison in new plans, and hypothesis_comparison stays valid for earlier records. instrument_composition added in 1.15.0: made by host code, never planned by the model; it orders the instruments the composer returns and may rewrite their two caption sentences under the host validators.

mapAssetUri.description: URI of the display raster, absolute or relative to the application origin (widened in 1.6.0 from an absolute URI).

componentKind.description: explanation_branches added in 1.10.0 (proposed): binds the ExplanationBranch records of one command and their BranchMerge. layer_stack, cross_section, pixel_anatomy, rainfall_scatter and field_plan added in 1.11.0: each binds exactly one InstrumentSpec.

origin.description: focus_entity is accepted only for user_command

fieldPlan.description: Added in 1.8.0; present exactly when kind is field_validation_plan (host rule). Optional so earlier records stay valid.

schemaVersion.description: Contract version the instance was written against; producers write the newest, and earlier versions of the same MAJOR stay valid.
Contract version the instance was written against; producers write the newest, and earlier versions of the same MAJOR stay valid.

message.description: Rendered by host code from a template; never model-authored

spanId.description: Internal span this event belongs to; spans follow OpenTelemetry GenAI naming (research/technology/observability.md)

eventRecordRowRecords.description: Added in 1.3.0; optional so 1.2.0 snapshots stay valid.

contextFeatureRecords.description: Added in 1.6.0; optional so earlier snapshots stay valid.

explanationBranchRecords.description: Added in 1.9.0; optional so earlier snapshots stay valid.

branchMergeRecords.description: Added in 1.9.0; optional so earlier snapshots stay valid.

instrumentSpecRecords.description: Added in 1.11.0; optional so earlier snapshots stay valid.

schemaVersion.description: Contract version the instance was written against; producers write the newest, and earlier versions of the same MAJOR stay valid.
Contract version the instance was written against; producers write the newest, and earlier versions of the same MAJOR stay valid.

argumentSummary.description: Sanitized, human-readable summary written by host code; never raw prompts or secrets

reasoningTokens.description: Billed as output tokens by the provider

webSearchCalls.description: Built-in search calls reported in the response; billing per call to be verified

replayOrigin.description: Added in 1.7.0: on the replay route only, where the replayed output came from (synthetic: written by hand for a test or demo; recorded: captured from a live call). Absent on the live Model API route; provider is then not "replay".

EventRecordRow.description: One dated event in a validated event bundle (docs/reference/data-contracts.md). A row is not evidence; a task that uses it proposes scientific_context evidence citing the same locator.

eventStart.description: ISO date, year-month or year, as the source states it.

excerpt.description: Verbatim excerpt, at most 300 Unicode code points.

sourceLanguage.description: BCP 47 tag of the source text, for example en, fr or ar.

statementEn.description: Model-drafted English statement; a machine-drafted translation only when sourceLanguage is not English.

ContextFeature.description: A located feature a view needs (an outlet, a settlement, later a viewpoint or a river line), with where its position comes from. Added in 1.6.0 as points; lines added in 1.12.0. Never evidence: no claim rests on it.

role.description: drainage, transect and route_proposed added in 1.12.0 and are lines; the others are points. Each role fits one kind of geometry (the allOf rules below).

dataBundle.description: Added in 1.12.0, optional: the bundle asset a line was read from, when it was. The seed loader writes it for the lines it reads from a bundle, with `member` set when the asset holds several lines of the role.

streamOrder.description: Added in 1.12.0, optional, drainage only: the Strahler order of every line in the feature (the seed loader writes one drainage feature per order). Per-segment details stay in the bundle asset named by dataBundle.

FieldStratum.description: Added in 1.8.0: a stratum of a field-validation plan, a kind of place to sample, never a sampling point (CMP-13: the local team chooses sites).

dataBundleId.description: The bundle the stratum is drawn from, when it is drawn from one.

FieldMeasurement.description: Added in 1.8.0: one row of the measurement table (CMP-13): what, method, season, strata, the field role, and the gaps and hypotheses it would resolve.

resolvesGapIds.description: Accepted field_requirement Evidence this measurement would close.

discriminatesHypothesisIds.description: Hypotheses this measurement would tell apart.

DeferredGap.description: Added in 1.8.0: an open gap the plan does not measure, with the reason.

FieldPlan.description: Added in 1.8.0: the content of a field_validation_plan action (CMP-13, DF-06). Every measurement names a gap or hypothesis it resolves; every open gap of the case is measured or deferred with a reason (host rule).

PredictionTest.description: Added in 1.9.0: what a prediction tests, in a closed grammar against recipe outputs and bundle metadata. Each kind sets its fields and leaves the others null or empty (host rule): departure_sign (pairId, side, periodIds; expected negative or positive), co_movement (pairId, windowMonths; expected same_sign_majority or no_same_sign_majority), season_category (seasonId; expected below_normal, near_normal or above_normal), quality_flag (pairId, side, periodIds, flag; expected present or absent), availability (pairId, side, periodIds; expected all_available or some_unavailable), field_check (fieldCheckId; expected null), trend_direction (stratumId, trendSeries; expected increasing, decreasing or flat).

pairId.description: A series pair of the case analysis configuration.

flag.description: A monthly quality flag of the STAC Item (siterra:quality_flags).

fieldCheckId.description: A field check of the case analysis configuration.

stratumId.description: A stratum ID in a long-record trend summary, such as catchment or elevation_high.

trendSeries.description: Which long-record trend series to test: unadjusted greenness or rainfall-adjusted residual.

Prediction.description: Added in 1.9.0: one prediction of an explanation branch, committed before any result of the branch is read. The model drafts the test and the wording; host code scores it and never reads the wording to decide anything.

necessary.description: A necessary prediction that is not met on adequate data contradicts the explanation.

PredictionScore.description: Added in 1.9.0: how host code scored one prediction against the record. not_testable always has dataAdequate false and a reason code.

observed.description: Host-written: what the record shows for the test, or why it cannot be tested.

BranchModelOutcome.description: Added in 1.9.0: the model call and independent check of one branch (TR-07).

ExplanationBranch.description: Added in 1.9.0: one candidate explanation tested as a branch. Revision 1 holds the predictions, committed before any result of the branch is read (DF-07); revision 2 holds the scores and the status the fixed merge rules set (DF-08). The status is never a probability or a rank, and never proof.

explanationId.description: An explanation of the case analysis configuration.

statement.description: The host-written statement of the explanation, from the case analysis configuration.

statusReason.description: Host-written: which rule set the status.

predictedAt.description: When host code drafted the predictions commit, before any result of the branch was read.

predictionsCaseRevision.description: The case revision the predictions commit produced; null on revision 1, set when scored.

hypothesisId.description: The Hypothesis record host code writes from the scored branch, for interventions and the brief.

BranchConflict.description: Added in 1.9.0: what the merge flags. separates_nothing: every branch predicts the same outcome of the same test, so the result cannot tell them apart. not_testable: the record holds nothing to score the prediction against. inadequate_data: the record holds the target, but not enough usable values.

ExplanationPair.description: Added in 1.10.0: two configured explanation IDs, ordered by code point, that a field measurement can tell apart.

BranchFieldPlan.description: Added in 1.10.0: the field plan as a minimum test cover (DF-09). measurements is the smallest set of the case's configured field checks that separates every pair of explanations the merge leaves open (pairs of explanations not contradicted); ties go to the set earliest in configuration order. Each measurement names the open pairs it separates and the pairs only it separates, so removing any one leaves a named pair unseparated. unseparated lists open pairs no configured check separates. Which pairs a check separates is a configured judgment, not a result.

BranchMerge.description: Added in 1.9.0: the fixed merge of one command's explanation branches. Statuses come from the scores alone: contradicted when a necessary prediction is not met on adequate data, consistent when every testable prediction is met and at least one is testable, cannot_be_assessed otherwise. fieldPlan added in 1.10.0.

fieldPlan.description: Added in 1.10.0; optional so merges written before it stay valid.

BundleAssetRef.description: One file of a validated observation bundle, named by the bundle and the asset key its collection lists. Added in 1.11.0. The bundle revision is pinned once, in the provenance.inputVersions of the record that holds the reference.

assetKey.description: The key of the asset in the bundle's STAC collection.

InstrumentCaption.description: The words beside an instrument: a claim in ink, its limit in grey, and the records the numbered chips open. Added in 1.11.0. Host rules in data-contracts.md (INST-05) check each sentence against the cited records.

grey.description: The limit or scope of the claim, one sentence.

claimKind.description: The kind of the ink sentence; the interface shows it with the sentence.

citationIds.description: Evidence or Measurement records of the case, in the order of the numbered chips.

data.description: The asset the sheet is drawn from.

LayerStackParameters.description: Data layers stacked as sheets over the catchment. layers are listed top sheet first and numbered in that order.

geoSelectionId.description: The area the instrument is about (a GeoSelection).

relief.description: The relief the sheets stand over.

drainageFeatureIds.description: ContextFeature records with the role drainage.

placeFeatureIds.description: ContextFeature points: the outlet and the places named on the land.

CrossSectionParameters.description: The catchment cut along one line, the cut face shown with the bands, their trends and their snow.

geoSelectionId.description: The area the instrument is about (a GeoSelection).

transectFeatureId.description: A ContextFeature record with the role transect: the cut line.

relief.description: The relief the cut is taken from.

profile.description: The samples along the cut line.

bands.description: The elevation bands and their limits.

snow.description: Snow cover by band and month.

drainageFeatureIds.description: ContextFeature records with the role drainage.

placeFeatureIds.description: ContextFeature points named on the land.

PixelAnatomyParameters.description: One coarse satellite pixel opened into the finer cells inside it. The anatomy asset names the pixel.

geoSelectionId.description: The area the instrument is about (a GeoSelection).

locator.description: The trend grid the pixel is located on.

anatomy.description: The pixel's cells, class spectra and season series.

bandSeries.description: The season series of the pixel's elevation band.

contextEvidenceIds.description: scientific_context Evidence records shown as cited text.

RainfallScatterParameters.description: Each season as one point, rain against greenness, with the fit. The bundle's own primary windows are plotted.

geoSelectionId.description: The area the instrument is about (a GeoSelection).

fit.description: The fit, its interval and its gate.

FieldPlanParameters.description: The field checks that would tell the open explanations apart, drawn as a proposal.

geoSelectionId.description: The area the instrument is about (a GeoSelection).

branchMergeId.description: The BranchMerge record whose field plan is drawn.

anyOf.description: The field_validation_plan OperationalAction, when there is one.

routeFeatureIds.description: ContextFeature records with the role route_proposed.

InstrumentParameters.description: What an instrument shows, one object per kind, chosen by its kind field. References only: bundle assets, GeoSelection, ContextFeature, Evidence, BranchMerge and OperationalAction records. No value, camera, scale, colour, coordinate, URL, markup or code. Added in 1.11.0.

InstrumentSpec.description: What one instrument of the workspace shows, as a record of the case. Added in 1.11.0. A CanvasComponent of the same kind binds it at an exact revision; the interface draws only what it says. Host composed: the model drafts captions, never parameters.

status.description: stale when an input it cites has a newer revision (staleness propagation).

provenance.description: inputVersions cites every record the parameters and the caption name (INST-01).

prefixItems.description: Metres above the ground model's datum. The range covers the land and refuses a nodata value such as -9999.

Position.description: [longitude, latitude] or [longitude, latitude, elevation]. Added in 1.12.0. A feature has an elevation on every position or on none (stated in the Zod mirror's role rule).

ContextGeometry.description: Where a ContextFeature is: a point as in 1.6.0, or, added in 1.12.0, a line or a set of lines. All in EPSG:4326, GeoJSON order.

MeasurementSource.description: Added in 1.13.0, optional on a Measurement: where in a bundle asset the number was read. The seed loader reads the value, and the interval when there is one, at these RFC 6901 JSON pointers in the asset the bundle lists under assetKey, after the asset's checksum is verified, so a value is never typed in. The pointers address the asset file as the bundle lists it; array positions are part of a pointer. periodId stays an opaque name: the period is stated here in fields, and no code parses an ID.

assetKey.description: The key under which the bundle's collection lists the asset.

jsonPointer.description: RFC 6901 pointer to the number in the asset (value).

stratum.description: The part of the place the number describes, as the bundle names it (for example catchment, elevation_low).

claimKind.description: The bundle's claim kind for this number; the loader refuses a row that differs from the bundle.

start.description: First year (YYYY) or month (YYYY-MM) the number covers.

end.description: Last year (YYYY) or month (YYYY-MM) the number covers.

window.description: The part of each year a repeated window covers, by the bundle's own label (for example mar_jun); null for a plain month or year span.

lowerJsonPointer.description: Pointer to the lower end of the interval in uncertainty, or null.

upperJsonPointer.description: Pointer to the upper end of the interval in uncertainty, or null. Both pointers are present or both are null (MS-01).

ContextLineSource.description: The bundle asset a ContextFeature line was read from. Added in 1.14.0. Like BundleAssetRef, with the id the asset gives to the one line of several that this feature is.

assetKey.description: The key of the asset in the bundle's STAC collection.

member.description: The asset's own id for the line (for example a transect id such as tabant_meridian), for an asset that holds several lines of one role. Never the display name.

DrawnAsset.description: A bundle asset an instrument draws besides the ones its named fields hold, with the plain-word role it plays (for example catchment_outline or pixel_cells). Added in 1.16.0. The interface asks the read API for the asset by bundle and key, so no address is built from a hash.

DrawnAssets.description: The other bundle assets the instrument draws, one per role (the Zod mirror refuses a repeated role). Added in 1.16.0; optional, so earlier specs stay valid.
